DeployBot: PROD deploy started for service `inference-runner` → prod-usw2. Commit: d4e5f1a (author: @alice). Tag: release/v3.6.2. Release window: 2026-08-17 23:00-23:30 UTC. Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Canary checks: latency p95, error-rate, model-regression-hash. Auto-fallback: on failure revert to commit c9a7b21. Link: https://releases.redwood.ai/r/3.6.2 :rocket:

alice: ack. I'll watch deployment and tagging. @bob you on monitoring? @carla pls sanity-check canary logs.

bob: on it, watching RUM and infra dashboards. Will post smoke after canary stabilizes.

DeployBot: Canary rollout started (5% traffic) — pods: inference-runner-v3.6.2-rc -> 3 replicas. Health checks passing (3/3).

carla: quick smoke: call to /v1/generate returned 200, sample tokens look okay. No obvious model hallucination in spot-check.

DeployBot: Canary metrics @ 5% — latency p95 +2% (baseline), error-rate 0.0%, model-regression-hash: MATCH. Proceeding to 50% per policy.

alice: nice. moving to 50% when deploybot says go.

DeployBot: Traffic shifted to 50%. Autoscaler scaled to 8 pods. Running KV-cache warmup. Observability link: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/3951234567/metrics

bob: Observability: no spike in infra CPU, request rate as expected. p50/p95 stable. No alerts triggered.

carla: running targeted eval set (quick-regress). All checks green except one low-confidence prompt, not blocking.

DeployBot: Final promotion: shifting to 100% traffic. Performing final pre-cutover validations.

DeployBot: CUTOVER COMPLETE — release/v3.6.2 (d4e5f1a) now serving 100% production traffic in prod-usw2. Duration: 12m 13s. Post-deploy actions: pin tag, update changelog, notify support. :tada:

release-notes-bot: Release notes draft created and linked: https://git.redwood.ai/release-notes/v3.6.2. To finalize run:
```
git tag -a v3.6.2 d4e5f1a -m "release v3.6.2"
git push origin v3.6.2
```
alice: thanks all — closing the window. I'll follow up with a short summary in #product and bump the support playbook.

bob: will keep an eye on dashboards for 60m, will page if latency >20% or error-rate >0.5%.

carla: QA will run the extended test-suite tomorrow morning.

DeployBot: Deploy thread closed. If you need to rollback run the rollback playbook or ping @oncall. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/3951234567 :white_check_mark:
